title: Export Contacts | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Export Contacts Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000057105 Once the users of the site register for the newsletter, the admin can export a list of members that have successfully registered on the site. There are associated reasons for doing this, such as marketing campaigns, promos, etc. To get started navigate to Emails >> View Contacts >> Once in the contact list, at the top right corner will be the " Export Contact Results" button: After clicking the Export button, click on "Yes, continue" to confirm the export: Finally, a CSV file with the member's information will be downloaded to the browser: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
